display_long_description:
Welcome to Palm City – a sun-soaked coastal paradise inspired by classic Miami vibes! Dive into a living, breathing open-world experience where freedom is everything.

Use your real hands to punch rivals in the streets, start brawls, or settle scores up close and personal. Grab a ball and play basketball or volleyball on the beach with friends. 

[media]
Jump behind the wheel and drive cars through bustling streets and scenic coastal roads. Grab your weapons and engage in intense gunfights as chaos unfolds around you.
Whether you’re completing missions, exploring every corner of the city, interacting with NPCs, or teaming up (or fighting against) other players in multiplayer mode, Palm Vice delivers nonstop action and emergent gameplay.

True VR Immersion: Realistic hand tracking, physics-based interactions, and full freedom of movement.
Free-to-Play Multiplayer Sandbox: Jump in anytime – no upfront cost. Customize your experience with in-app purchases (cosmetics, vehicles, and more coming soon).
Endless Possibilities: Street fights, sports, driving, shooting, and chaotic fun in a beautiful low-poly coastal city built with Synty’s Palm City assets.
Play Solo or with Friends: Build your crew, cause mayhem, or just chill and enjoy the vibrant Palm City atmosphere.

If you’ve been waiting for that true GTA-style freedom in VR, this is it. Palm Vice brings the streets to life.
Download now for free and start your adventure in Palm City today!
